notes.title: Playtest 0.2.0 Is Now Live!
notes.content:
Changelog Version 0.2.0

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/8f78ed3390464ef9af311f203ba77ae82918fda0.png[/img]
- New Mac and Linux builds for testing purposes
- Map now displays the player direction for better navigation
- Added introductory letter to the starting inventory
- Upgraded map icons for the player, huts, plants, standing torches and cats
- Increased the density of items in all biomes by 10 to 30%
- Sunset/sunrise transitions are now 7x slower, giving a more natural look
- Player can now build their own chests inside huts
- Added chocolate as a consumable item sold in shops
- Some sweet recipes now contain chocolate as an ingredient
- Reduced market value of fairy dust by 50%
- Reduced market value of ores and ingots by 25%
- Minor adjustments to the market value of ancient artifacts
- Reduced negative health effect of pizzas
- Reduced daily chance of rain from 36 to 30%
- Stats frame around the screen is now darker to better blend with the game
- Scrolls and water buckets can now be sold at the shops
- Taming cats now plays an unique sound effect
- Cats and furniture are no longer attacked by spiderwebs
- Broom attack and cooldown reduced to fall in line with other tools
- Destroying wells and furnaces now give more resources
- Damage screen effect now displays less often when one of your stats reaches 0
- Tooltips now only display within 3 meters from the target
- Updated description of some craftable items
- Improved skirt physics
- Minor UI improvements

Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the furnace would not load properly
- Tamed cats no longer wander too far when told to stay
- Untamed cats no longer wander too far from the spawning position
- Player no longer stops sleeping without player input
- Fixed a bug where bears and boars would attack players in chill mode
- Fixed an issue where cats could not enter or exit huts
- Fixed an issue where cats in wander state would not load their position properly
- Minor fixes and adjustments

Known Bugs

- A very small chance of the player getting stuck on a loop while opening doors
- A very small chance that the player cannot use tools

Saving and loading will solve both issues while we investigate further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/533846f885f2781cd9f8339ba0f66be67e357a95.png[/img]
If you decide to join the playtest, we'd love to hear your feedback in the Steam forums or directly on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ

notes.title: Chill Mode, New Biome & Weather System
notes.content:
Chill Mode, New Biome & Weather System

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/ebb0a45aacf260b38a0e1161b7a1dc936b2347e8.png[/img]
Changelog Version 0.1.4

- New Chill Mode (no wolves, boars or monsters)
- New Swamp biome with 3 variations
- New Weather System with ultra-realistic graphics
- Abandoned town houses now have 4 different variations (1 previously)
- Added townhall building for large towns
- Rain and storm weather now reduce happiness and the need to drink
- Added craftable barrels and stools to the Mining Town biome
- Added 2 new food types
- Huts now have happiness aura, but spiderwebs have a strong negative effect
- Maze was revamped with more loot and new fantasy creatures
- NPC shops now sell 16 items each, including more books
- Books can be used as fuel for fire
- Updated main menu, loading screens and pause panel
- Building system improved to avoid creating furniture inside walls
- Minor UI improvements

Bug Fixes

- Fixed an exploit where you could buy infinite apple pies for free
- Fixed tutorial quest Lumberjack not completing
- Fixed a bug where torches could be built without spending any crafting items
- Torches lost its happiness aura and no longer can be used for cooking
- Minor fixes and adjustments

Quality of Life Features

- Walk/run speed is now toggled with SHIFT instead of 1 & 2
- Camera no longer rotates in dialogue mode or when UI panels are open
- World generator is now balanced with at least two zones for each biome
- Extensive shadow and mesh optimization to improve performance

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/34303cc74e1db31f93017f02608aada0ea2560bd.png[/img]
Important Note

If you start a new game from the main menu, it may load quest progress from a previous save. Press Esc and start a new game again - progress will be reset and the first quest "Gather" will appear. This bug is being investigated but for now follow this step and it should work without any issues.

Due to the procedural generation nature of the game, saves from previous versions do not feature new content. For the best experience, please start a new world.

We hope you are as excited as we are and can't wait to listen to your feedback!
Join our Discord for any questions and more information: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ

notes.title: Halloween Cat Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/2100c596b137ab728a4463479feeaf23226f39e4.png[/img]

In celebration of Halloween, the new Cat update just dropped and is now live! In addition to having cats as pets, there is now an entirely new Autumn biome! Pumpkin Woods is also taking part in the upcoming Steam Scream Fest 3 from October 28th to November 4th, so this update was focused on giving new players a smoother experience at the start.

Changelog Version 0.1.2

- Added an entirely new Autumn biome
- Added cats that can be tamed with a cheese slice by pressing F
- Pet cats can be ordered to switch between stay/follow behavior by pressing F
- Added craftable standing torch to avoid getting lost
- Added deer
- Axe and dagger no longer require a book to be crafted
- Books are now cheaper and can be sold at the shops
- Reduced damage from wild animals and plants
- Reduced poison effects from moonjuice and some mushrooms
- Hunger now depletes faster while not sleeping
- Rebalanced cart spawning for essential items
- Improved ground textures
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't use the anvil
- Pausing the game with Escape now properly hides journal
- Minor UI improvements
- Minor fixes and adjustments

Saves from previous versions are not supported. Please start a new world.

We hope you are as excited as we are and can't wait to listen to your feedback!
Join our Discord for any questions and more information: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ

notes.title: Pumpkin Woods Playtest
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release date of the first ever Pumpkin Woods Playtest! Starting October 1st till Halloween, you will be able to play as much as you want! While you wait, learn more about the 4 biomes included in this version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/68c6fe42156d32e3bc53ab23d25d8f7ea0a1c793.png[/img]
[b]The Woods[/b]
The gateway to the region is a calm and bucolic forest with scattered pine trees and vast open areas. Being the safest and most well known biome, it's the favorite place by the local inhabitants to set up traditional Halloween decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/ae8f2388b41bcdd85cb42776f311b1a471f6a7c1.png[/img]
[b]Pumpkin Woods[/b]
This infamous forest with giant pumpkins is strictly avoided by most folks due to the ever growing presence of wolves and harmful plants. The sunlight is blocked by ancient overgrown trees while crows eerily warn those who venture in these dark woods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/3adbbacba51ca943dfbe51d218b23319409fcb6f.png[/img]
[b]Enchanted Forest[/b]
Also known as Fairywood, these secluded and pristine areas are nothing short of magical. Known to possess mystical creatures and otherworldly flora, it has mostly been left untouched due to old legends about those who never return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792401/07c848eaffa3985e54387651b9c75533cee5d9fd.png[/img]
[b]Mining Town[/b]
Following the discovery of large precious gems, settlers from far away lands rushed to this mostly barren region. Its golden days are long gone, and these now isolated settlements are more akin to ghost towns.

[b]Important information about Playtest 1.0![/b]

Here's what you can already do:
- Explore a full sized map
- Craft basic survival items
- Build your cozy witch home
- Meet folks and their shops
- No time restrictions

[u]Some limitations of this current version:[/u]
- First playtest so it may contain critical bugs
- You won't be able to fly on a broom
- There are no cat pets at this time
- Everything is subject to change (balance / map generation)
- There is only 1 save available, not compatible with upcoming versions

Here is what you can try doing if you're really adventurous (not fully fleshed out):
- Brew potions
- Build your own wagon

If you decide to join the playtest, we'd love to hear your feedback in the Steam forums or directly on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/warRP5bDFJ


Have fun in October!
